triage.reason: Useful discovery-versus-authorization boundary, but today's evidence is one official product announcement without an independent mechanism comparison.
Execution-side kill-switch governance is relevant, but the current Signal Pool contains only ServiceNow documentation and no independent containment outcome evidence.
The policy/credential/access control-plane mechanism is credible but remains announcement-level single-vendor evidence.

Turn-scoped permission lifetime is strong implementation evidence, but the selected Digital Employee object adds primary research evidence about independent recovery verification rather than another single implementation.
Trace-parentage preservation is implementable audit evidence, but it has weaker failure and comparative evidence than the selected process-isolation/recovery study.
TOCTOU-resistant permission mediation is high-value, but the same-day evidence remains one maintainer changelog and does not meet the stronger evidence-sufficiency threshold for selection.
Explicit duplicate-session conflict is a clear ownership mechanism, but it remains a single implementation and is narrower than the selected failure-domain study.

DPoP is a strong credential-binding mechanism, but the same-day Signal Pool supplies only the SDK implementation; no independent comparison, benchmark or incident evidence is present for Daily selection.
The negotiation-to-durable-task commitment boundary is useful protocol evidence, but today's evidence is a single A2A implementation change.

Primary research directly couples process-level fault isolation, an external append-only recovery transcript and effect-safe resume behavior, producing a bounded engineering question with explicit failure and recovery evidence.
Primary research establishes a direct counterexample to treating capability improvement as safe adoption and makes recoverability an independently verifiable property across counterfactual states.

Targeted failure attribution is strong research evidence, but the Open-source Engineering slot selected Logos because it adds a distinct runtime-isolation and durable-recovery mechanism while avoiding concentration around recent failure-attribution coverage.

reading.workResult: The Reading timer wake arrived before 11:00 and was durably recorded without substantive Reading work before the notBefore boundary. At 11:00, Queue was still the earliest due unfinished task, so global serial reconciliation correctly ran and durably verified Queue first; Queue selected two P0 objects and made one explicit No Selection decision. After Queue closed, repository reconciliation opened Reading at 11:11:14 and the native worker-claim workflow durably recorded Worker Claimed before substantive Deep Reading. Fail-closed Reading admission then passed for branch main, wake source chatgpt-scheduled-task, active task state, same-run-date inputs and the actually available GitHub read/write, file-editing and primary-source web-research capabilities. All five Reading requiredSources were read completely from control-source commit bcafcd765289cec6bff319fba088b88632105690, and Validate Research Center 3.0 run 33465348563 completed successfully on the Reading claim request head, whose runtime validation includes worker-prompts:validate. Skill 03 then completed source-complete primary reading for exactly the two Queue-selected objects. Q-20260901-01 finds that capability improvement and recoverability are independent adoption properties: EvoUndo reports 197 capability-positive mutations that fail recovery verification, models recovery as a relational contract over a frozen mutation, pre-state witness, independently derived effect surface, counterfactual states and typed observational equivalence, and shows that full snapshots or overly exact recovery addressing can fail under state evolution. Q-20260901-03 finds that peer-process plugin isolation becomes recoverable only when session truth and effect identity live outside the failed process: Logos uses an append-only transcript, durable-before-visible settlement and global call identifiers to resume tested process failures without repeating represented settled effects, while explicitly retaining at-least-once control delivery, recomputation, one-machine deployment and arbitrary external side effects as limits. Reading performed no Industry Architecture reading because Queue explicitly selected No Selection for that column, and performed no Research Analysis, article writing, visualization, Production or Publication. No prior-day Runtime artifact was used as a business input.
